verdict.rationale: Signifyd markets a first-party Chargeback Recovery product. Its API lets merchants record chargebacks against orders and record the outcome of a chargeback's representment, which implies Signifyd handles representment. The pack does not show evidence being compiled automatically or submitted to issuers. Missing for 10: documentation of automated evidence compilation from order, delivery, and session data; documentation of automated submission to the issuer without manual work; independent or hands-on corroboration of automated chargeback responses.

support.subject: As an ops user, chargeback responses are automated — evidence compiled from order, delivery, and session data and submitted to the issuer without manual copy-paste

citations.quote: Chargeback Recovery Take charge of your chargebacks
To create a chargeback against an Order in the Signifyd system, you need to record a Chargeback Event.
To set the outcome of a Chargeback's Representment in the Signifyd system, you need to record a Representment Outcome Event.
